# `GSensorMove`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Envelope-only notification that the motion sensor detected the device or mount being moved.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | event (device sends) |
| Grade | PURE GETTER |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, sendSensorData @0x132ca0 (64-bit build) |

Broadcast on TCP 4700 (channel I) from the sensor sampling timer when it detects mount or device motion; the same branch clears the three-point polar-alignment calibration and notifies that the mount moved. No fixed delivery rate. Family N (Event and Timestamp only). APK consumer: none established.

Side effects: Observation only for the receiver. On the device the detecting branch clears the three-point polar-alignment calibration.

## Request params

None. Events are sent by the device without a request; the payload is below.

## Payload

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Event` | string | yes | - | Discriminator. Fixed value `"GSensorMove"`. [READ] |
| `Timestamp` | string | yes | - | Decimal string with nine fractional digits from a monotonic clock; not a calendar time. [READ] |

## Errors

None. Failures appear in the payload (`code`, `error`) when `state` is `fail`.

## Example

Event, moved - READ shape, not captured:

```json
{"Event":"GSensorMove","Timestamp":"1234.123456789"}
```
